mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_id AS providerId, model_id AS modelId, display_name AS displayName, remark, reasoning_efforts AS reasoningEfforts, status, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM ai_model_provider_model WHERE provider_id IN #{item} ORDER BY provider_id, sort_order, id

SELECT m.id AS id, m.provider_id AS providerId, p.vendor AS vendor, p.name AS providerName, m.model_id AS modelId, m.display_name AS displayName, m.reasoning_efforts AS reasoningEfforts FROM ai_model_provider_model m JOIN ai_model_provider p ON p.id = m.provider_id WHERE m.status = 'ENABLED' AND p.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY p.name, m.sort_order, m.id
